$comment: Files already over the 200-line rule when the guard was added, with the length each had. The guard's only job is to stop the list growing: a new file over 200 lines fails, and a file here that grows fails. Splitting any of these is optional and always allowed -- shrink past 200 and delete the entry. Per the roadmap decision, files are split when a phase touches them, not on a schedule, so this is a debt ledger and not a work queue.
